about_the_game:
Yaarmi Tycoon arrives with its first playable version, v0.1.0-alpha, marking the beginning of this digital growth simulation game. In this early stage, the foundation of the progression and economy systems is introduced, allowing players to start building their content creation empire. Throughout the game, videos are uploaded automatically every 20 to 50 seconds, generating income based on the active upgrades. Each upload features a progress bar to simulate the uploading process, and once completed, your earnings increase—opening the door to new upgrade opportunities.

The game features a functional upgrade system through the core component of your setup: the computer. This can be improved across four different areas: Hard Drive & RAM, Games, CPU, and Peripherals. Each upgrade has its own leveling system, showing the current level, income per video, and the cost required to reach the next level. It’s important to note that income boosts don’t apply immediately—instead, they take effect with the next video upload. Once an upgrade reaches its maximum level, it becomes fixed and can no longer be improved, but continues to generate consistent earnings.

A loading menu has also been added, including a progress bar while the game initializes, enhancing immersion right from the start. However, it’s important to remember that this is an alpha version, mainly focused on testing the core logic of progression and basic economic balance. The interface and visual design are still temporary, and many values, timings, and rewards are subject to change in future updates. At this stage, there is no save system available, meaning all progress will be lost upon closing the game.

Yaarmi Tycoon will be updated frequently, bringing new mechanics, balance adjustments, and overall improvements based on community feedback. To stay informed about each update, you can visit the official website where a detailed post will be published outlining all changes, additions, and fixes in every new version.

Thank you for playing and being part of the development journey. Your support and feedback are essential to shaping and improving this digital simulation experience.

Yaarmi Tycoon Progress Update

Hey everyone! 👋

It’s been a while since we last released a game update on Steam, and we want to explain why: we’ve been rewriting a big part of the core code. This will allow us to properly implement the components shop and, more importantly, set up a solid foundation for adding many more improvements inside the game.

Because of this work, the new features we announced during Yaarmi Live will start to appear in the coming weeks inside Yaarmi Tycoon.

Here’s a quick look at where we are right now:

🔹 We’ve already rewritten the internal logic system, making it easier and more stable to develop future improvements.
🔹 We’re currently working on the implementation of components, which is a key part of upcoming content.
🔹 Over the past couple of days we’ve taken a short 1–2 day break to run a UI design session. Before diving deeper into coding, we want to define exactly how the interface should look and behave, ensuring that logic and design blend together as smoothly as possible.

This step won’t just make the game clearer and more enjoyable to use — it will also lay the groundwork for some future surprises 🎉.

Thanks so much for your patience and support 💙. Very soon you’ll start seeing Yaarmi Tycoon take its next big steps!

Yaarmi Tycoon – Changelog v1.0.0-alpha

🚀 Main Highlights

  • First consolidated alpha release of Yaarmi Tycoon.

  • Integrates and unifies progression, video uploading, economy, and component upgrade systems.

🔧 New Features

📥 Loading Menu

  • Functional loading menu with a progress bar showing game load status.

💰 Money & Earnings System

  • You automatically earn money every time a video is uploaded.

  • Earnings depend on the active upgrades on your laptop.

📤 Video Upload System

  • Every 20 to 40 seconds, a new video is uploaded automatically (adjusted from the previous 20 to 50 seconds).

  • Progress bar during upload.

  • Once completed, money increases based on your current earnings per video.

🖥️ Laptop Components & Upgrade System

The laptop includes multiple upgrades, each with levels that boost earnings per video.

✅ Available Upgrades:

  • CPU

    • L1: Cost 25 | +1.50

    • L2: Cost 50 | +1.00

    • L3: Cost 60 | +0.60

    • L4: Cost 80 | +0.60

    • L5: Cost 100 | +0.80

  • Games

    • L1: Cost 100 | +2.50

    • L2: Cost 150 | +1.50

    • L3: Cost 200 | +1.00

    • L4: Cost 250 | +1.00

    • L5: Cost 350 | +2.00

  • Hard Drive

    • L1: Cost 45 | +1.50

    • L2: Cost 80 | +0.80

    • L3: Cost 100 | +0.80

    • L4: Cost 125 | +0.40

    • L5: Cost 160 | +1.50

  • RAM

    • L1: Cost 40 | +0.50

    • L2: Cost 70 | +0.75

    • L3: Cost 100 | +0.75

    • L4: Cost 120 | +1.00

    • L5: Cost 150 | +2.00

  • Charger

    • L1: Cost 5 | +0.25

    • L2: Cost 15 | +0.25

    • L3: Cost 25 | +0.50

    • L4: Cost 50 | +0.25

    • L5: Cost 100 | +1.00

  • Keyboard

    • L1: Cost 20 | +0.25

    • L2: Cost 40 | +0.25

    • L3: Cost 55 | +0.50

    • L4: Cost 80 | +1.00

    • L5: Cost 100 | +0.50

  • Screen

    • L1: Cost 30 | +0.45

    • L2: Cost 60 | +0.30

    • L3: Cost 95 | +0.35

    • L4: Cost 130 | +0.50

    • L5: Cost 175 | +0.90

❌ Removed Upgrades:

  • Peripherals (no longer available as an upgrade).

🖼️ Interface & Usability

  • The upgrade interface now scales proportionally to the screen resolution (98% * 70%).

  • Improved playability across different screen types.

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • YT-0001: Fixed a bug that prevented buying upgrades if you had exactly the required amount of money (was incorrectly showing “insufficient funds”).

🧪 Current Game Status

  • Economy values and timers are still under balancing.

  • UI and visuals remain provisional.

  • Player feedback is essential for upcoming improvements.


📢 Alpha System in Yaarmi Tycoon

Hi everyone!
We’d like to explain how the alpha system works in Yaarmi Tycoon, so you know what to expect from each update and how to read the version numbers.

🔢 Version Naming

All versions follow this format:
x.x.x-alpha

  • First number (x.0.0-alpha) → Current main version of the game.

  • Second number (0.x.0-alpha) → Experimental version in development for the next major update.

  • Third number (0.0.x-alpha) → Quick hotfix versions that solve urgent bugs.

👉 Example: 0.1.0-alpha
This means we’re currently working toward the future 1.0.0-alpha, and many features or implementations may still change.

🛠️ Important

  • All releases are alphas, which means content and systems may change at any time.

  • Updates are automatic and mandatory for all players.

📅 Release Frequency

  • Main versions: at most once per week, but usually every 2–3 weeks (sometimes longer).

  • Development versions: every 1–2 weeks, but only if there isn’t a main version that same week.

  • Bugfix patches: released as soon as the issue is solved.

Thanks for joining us in this stage of Yaarmi Tycoon’s development!
Your feedback is essential to help us improve the game and move toward more stable versions. 🚀


Yaarmi Tycoon. 0.1.0-alpha

📝 Yaarmi Tycoon – Changelog v0.1.0-alpha

First playable version of Yaarmi Tycoon!
This initial alpha sets the foundation for video uploading, money management, and upgrade systems. Here's what's new:

🔧 New Features

📥 Loading Menu

  • Added a working loading screen.

  • Includes a progress bar showing load status.

💰 Money & Earnings System

  • Money system is now active.

  • You earn money every time a video is uploaded, based on your current upgrades.

📤 Video Upload System

  • A video is automatically uploaded every 20 to 50 seconds.

  • Upload system includes:

    • Progress bar while uploading.

    • When the video finishes uploading, money is added according to your current video earnings.

🖥️ Computer Component with Upgrade System

  • Introduced the Computer component, featuring 4 individual upgrades:

    • Hard Drive & RAM

    • Games

    • CPU

    • Peripherals

🔧 Component Upgrade Mechanics

  • Each upgrade has its own progression system with:

    • Level: Displays current level and total available levels.

    • Earnings per video:

      • Shows current earnings for that upgrade.

      • Shows how much will be added in the next level.

    • Upgrade cost: Shows the amount of money required to unlock the next level.

  • ⚠️ Note: Upgrades do not take effect immediately. The new earnings only apply after the next video is uploaded.

  • Once an upgrade reaches its maximum level, it will display:

    • Current level / max level

    • Final fixed video earnings for that upgrade

🧪 Current Game State

  • This version focuses on testing the core progression and economy logic.

  • Values, timers, and rewards will be balanced in future updates.

  • UI and visuals are placeholders and will be improved.

Thanks for trying out Yaarmi Tycoon! This is just the beginning of your journey to virtual stardom.
Your feedback is essential to help shape the game’s future! 🚀🎬
